caseName: Davis ex rel. LaShonda D. v. Monroe County Board of Education
caseNameFull: Davis, as Next Friend of LaShonda D. v. Monroe County Board of Education

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 524 U. S. 980.] Motion of American Civil Liberties Union et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
